title: Chief Executive Order 32 Legal Framework Second Amendment Order 2002

sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 32 Legal Framework Second Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

LEGAL FRAMEWORK (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
LEGAL FRAMEWORK
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 32 OF 2002
An order further
to amend the Legal Framework Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary Part I, dated 26-10-2002]
F.No.2(2)/2002-Pub. dated
26-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Order may be called the Legal Framework (Second
Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of the Schedule Chief Executive's Order No.24 of 2002

LEGAL FRAMEWORK (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
LEGAL FRAMEWORK
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 32 OF 2002
An order further
to amend the Legal Framework Order, 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary Part I, dated 26-10-2002]
F.No.2(2)/2002-Pub. dated
26-10-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of the Schedule
Chief Executive's Order No.24 of 2002.---In the Legal Framework Order 2002
(Chief Executive's Order No.24 of 2002) in the Schedule,---
(1) in column (1), in serial
number 5 relating to Article 59, in column (3), in clause (1), in sub-clause
(b), the words "by direct and free vote" shall be omitted and shall
be deemed to have always been so omitted: and
(2) in column (1)-in serial number
17 relating to Part V, Chapter 3, in column (3) in the entry relating to
Article 152-A, in clause (3), after the word "convened" the word
"regularly" shall be inserted and the words "within the time
frame indicated by him" shall be omitted.
